name: Wedding & Reception
description: Comprehensive template for traditional and modern weddings with multi-day rituals, ceremonies, and reception.

default_budget_split.reasoning: Banquet hall/resort rental, lawn charges, stage infrastructure, and lighting.
Buffet courses, live counters, welcome drinks, desserts, and hospitality staff.
Mandap/altar, entrance arches, floral arrangements, seating, and table centrepieces.
Candid photographer, cinematic videographer, drone shots, and pre-wedding shoot.
DJ setup, sound system, MC/host, and traditional performers (dhol/sangeet).
Bridal makeup artist, hairstylist, drape artist, and grooming.
Printed invitation boxes/cards, digital WhatsApp cards, itinerary booklets.
Guest pickup, vintage wedding car, luggage shuttle, and parking coordination.
Priest/pandit dakshina, puja materials, safa/pagdi, and guest hampers.
Buffer for unexpected last-minute additions, overtime charges, or extra plates.

timeline_milestones.title: Finalize Event Date & Book Main Venue
Shortlist and Book Catering Team & Sample Menu
Lock Decor Theme, Color Palette & Floral Concept
Design & Send Wedding Invitations / WhatsApp RSVP
Book Bridal Makeup Artist & Schedule Trial
Coordinate Sound, DJ Playlist & Sangeet Choreography
Confirm Final RSVP Count with Caterer and Table Seating
Conduct Venue Walkthrough & Generator / Electrical Check
Assemble Welcome Bags & Welcome Outstation Guests
Rehearsal, Sound Check & Stage Setup Handover
Day-of Run of Show Execution & Ritual Facilitation

tone: Warm, celebratory, respectful of cultural heritage, and joyous.
